headline: Sabesp Approves R$2.6 Billion in Interest on Equity
summary: Sabesp has approved a payment of R$2.6 billion in interest on equity, equivalent to R$0.75 per share. Shareholders must purchase the stock by December 10 to qualify.
why: Sabesp is a major water and sanitation utility in Brazil; dividend and interest payments are key factors for income-focused investors in the utility sector.
